target_customer: Senior living operators, home care providers and families caring for people with chronic conditions
problem: Older adults and chronic patients lack passive monitoring and timely, friendly care support at home.
business_model: Hardware plus software subscription for care providers
product_category: Voice AI and radar based digital care companion

founders.name: Brad Eckert
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led a 30 plus person engineering team at Cairns Health, formerly Totemic, built deep learning radars and has 25 plus patents.

founders.name: Kiran Joshi
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

founders.name: Neal Khosla
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

competitors.name: Orbita
competitors.what: Voice experience platform on Alexa for home health use such as medication adherence and monitoring
competitors.traction_then: Partnered with Libertana Home Health on Alexa Echo Dots

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed custom radar hardware with deep learning signal processing to detect heart rate, breathing and activity without a wearable, plus conversational AI.

defensibility.rationale: Hardware and radar algorithms with patents raise the bar, but voice companions can be copied by larger platforms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition by an incumbent found. Cairns acquired Together by Renee in October 2025.

market_need_then: Aging in place demand: a Dorm Room Fund profile from August 2017 described a wireless, camera free device to help seniors age safely at home.

branding.community_and_virality: A CES 2026 award is listed in aggregator news; no community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name shares a string with the Australian city and hospitals, and no press on the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Cairns Health began as Totemic Labs building radar based monitoring for seniors, added conversational voice AI, and was still operating in 2026 after acquiring Together by Renee in October 2025. Funding amounts are only aggregator estimates, so its scale and path are unclear.
notes: cairns.ai returned 404 on fetch, so the company site was not read. Seedtable lists a 5.3M seed in August 2017 with DCVC, Y Combinator, Dorm Room Fund, Lightspeed and Khosla Ventures, and says its allocations are estimates; another site says 35.1M raised. Neither is recorded as a round. The Orbita source is dated December 2016, within months before the S17 batch. The Totemic Labs name is from the YC page and a Dorm Room Fund description; the rename date is unknown. Founding year conflicts: YC says 2017, CB Insights says 2016. Only Brad Eckert has a bio on the YC page. Completeness pass: the 5.3M seed (Aug 2017, CB Insights dates it 2017-08-22) rests on databases only, Seedtable for the amount and CB Insights for the investors; no Form D or press found. The 35.1M total from Standout conflicts and is not recorded.
